item.title: Netflix Buys Warner Bros. for $82 Billion
item.description: It’s a dark, devastating day for the theatrical movie experience. After a banner year for Warner Bros, capped off by IMAX 70mm re-releases for One Battle After Another and Ryan Coogler’s Sinners next week, it’s now been officially confirmed that WB Discovery has been acquired by Netflix for $82.7 billion.
